messages:
sam (sales): NewBank POC question — they want 2k QPS steady, avg ~50 tokens, 99p <=120ms. They want a reserved pool + burst credits and a clear preheat/runbook. Need sizing + cost tradeoffs. cc @lee @anya
lee (solutions): Clarify: 2k QPS is global or regional? Peak multiplier? If they have spiky bursts we should plan for burst credits + AZ spread.
sam (sales): Global with primary traffic in us-east-1, eu-west-1. Expect 1.6x peak windows.
anya (eng): Rough ballpark calc: 2k qps * 50 tokens = 100k tokens/sec. With typical GPU throughput for autoregressive 7B-ish on A100 and 4-bit quant, one GPU ~12–18k tokens/sec depending on prompt shape. So steady-state reserved = ~6 GPUs if quantized. For headroom and 99p 120ms add 1–2 extra reserved or burst pool.
mike (infra): Agree. Autoscale policy recommendation: reserved pool = 6, burst pool = 2 (pre-warmed), autoscale target based on queue length + p99 latency. Use slow-start: scale step=1 GPU, cooldown=60s, max-burst=4. Ensure AZ-affinity across 2 AZs.
lee (solutions): Note: quantization reduces memory but increases compute; if they refuse 4-bit we need +50% GPUs. Ask if they accept 4-bit/awq/qlo.
jordan (solutions): Sending a quick traffic matrix for sizing tests:
``nregion,qps,peak_mult
us-east-1,1200,1.7
eu-west-1,800,1.6
```
anya (eng): For preheat/Warmup: run prefix/KV warmup with representative sessions. Example command we use in presales: 
```
redwoodctl preheat --model redwood-alpha-7b --requests-file traffic_sample.json --kv-warmup --parallel 16 --duration 8m
```
This warms KV caches and populates prefix hits; expect ~25–35% lower token load after warm.
eve (security): Security checklist reminders: Private VPC peering or Private control plane? KMS for keys, audit log retention, and SLA around data residency. These affect timeline for Private deployment but not sizing.
mike (infra): Also add eviction tolerance: set reserved eviction policy to never-evict for NewBank production. For POC we can allow preemptible burst but schedule fallback model variant with smaller memory (quantized) in policy.
sam (sales): Pricing Q from NewBank: cost for 6 reserved + 2 burst vs 8 reserved? They want monthly delta. Any quick estimate?
lee (solutions): Quick math: reserved is amortized capacity — cheaper per-token. If 1 reserved GPU costs X/month, 8 reserved = 8X. Burst credits pricing depends on hours used; rough break-even for steady >60% utilization -> reserve. I'll pull numbers from pricing table and DM finance.
anya (eng): Also consider request shaping: require prompt length limits and response token budgets to keep 99p under SLO. If they can cap at 128 tokens response we gain stability.
jordan (solutions): Action items: 1) Create presales runbook for NewBank (me) 2) Run a smoke preheat sim (anya + mike) 3) Pricing delta (lee) 4) Security Qs (eve).
deploy-bot: Preheat job created: link=https://deploys.internal/preheat/3749996543 status=queued owner=@anya
sam (sales): Perfect. Can we target a smoke run this Thurs PST? I'll coordinate with NewBank. :thumbsup:
anya (eng): Thurs works. I'll prepare traffic_sample.json with representative prefixes and a short script to simulate KV hits.
sam (sales): Thanks all — I'll update the customer and post back with any new asks.
